raw.verdict: A and D both grounded their answers in the same overview call, but A went further. It added the tone comparison chart, the substantive export claims (Rs 38,424 crore, 25-fold), a correct reading of 'critical', and executable follow-ups. B gave plausible official figures from memory and did not measure the news at all, and C declined to answer.
